title: Whispering Cavern
description: A cavern of echoes where every step can cost health.

sections.text: You enter the cavern and hear a whisper from the dark.

options.text: Stay near the lantern and walk east.

sections.text: The corridor narrows and a stone wolf watches you.

options.text: Calm the wolf with a song.

sections.text: You step into the crystal chamber and the cave whispers your name.
